mapper.sql: file_id, folder_id, name, original_name, stored_name, path, ext, size, content_type, uploader_id, uploader_name, version_num, upload_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM doc_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM doc_file WHERE folder_id = #{folderId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY upload_time DESC, file_id DESC
SELECT FROM doc_file WHERE deleted = 0 AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY upload_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc_file WHERE folder_id = #{folderId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_file (folder_id, name, original_name, stored_name, path, ext, size, content_type, uploader_id, uploader_name, version_num) VALUES (#{folderId}, #{name}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{path}, #{ext}, #{size}, #{contentType}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderName}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE doc_file SET name = #{name} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}

UPDATE doc_file SET original_name = #{originalName}, stored_name = #{storedName}, path = #{path}, size = #{size}, content_type = #{contentType}, version_num = #{versionNum}, upload_time = NOW() WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
UPDATE doc_file SET deleted = 1 WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
